name: Breadboard, 830 points
description: Full-size solderless breadboard (BusBoard BB830; the MB-102 has the same layout): 0.1 in pitch, strips of five holes either side of a 0.3 in channel, power rails along both edges.

functional.claims: 830 holes; each strip of five (63 a side) and each power rail is one conductor; strips across the centre channel and adjacent strips are isolated. The body (6.50 x 2.20 x 0.30 in, 165.1 x 54.6 x 8.5 mm), the 630-point IC area and the four continuous 50-point rails are the datasheet's (BPS-DOC-(BB830) Rev 7).
omissions: the holes' place on the body (the rails' and strips' offsets from its edges) is not dimensioned in the datasheet: 0.1 in pitch, the 0.3 in DIP channel and rail pairs 0.1 in apart, placed as the common layout

electrical.claims: 830 holes; each strip of five (63 a side) and each power rail is one conductor; strips across the centre channel and adjacent strips are isolated. The body (6.50 x 2.20 x 0.30 in, 165.1 x 54.6 x 8.5 mm), the 630-point IC area and the four continuous 50-point rails are the datasheet's (BPS-DOC-(BB830) Rev 7). The contacts are ideal.
omissions: contact resistance (tens of milliohms a contact)
capacitance between adjacent strips (a few pF)
the rating of 36 V and 2 A a contact is not enforced
